keyLimits.en: Entry tier covers 50 shipments/month, scaling to 174.99 USD/month at 5,000 shipments; 3 users included; basic automation, rate shopping, LTL comparison, return labels, email support

Entry tier from 50 shipments/month up to 100,000+ (3,599.99 USD/month at top tier); 10 users included; unlimited automations, order combining/splitting, API access, phone support, branded returns portal
Scales up to 7,499.99 USD/month at 100,000+ shipments; 15 users included; advanced inventory/warehouse management, custom analytics, ODBC access, dedicated implementation

cautions.en: Price scales by monthly shipment volume within each plan tier (e.g. Standard ranges from $29.99 to $3,599.99/month), not a flat fee; the entry price only applies at the lowest shipment tier.
Annual billing gives a 20% discount versus monthly; figures recorded here are monthly billing.

capabilities.en: Multi-carrier shipping label generation, rate shopping across carriers, and LTL freight comparison for e-commerce order fulfillment.
Order automation rules, order combining/splitting, and a branded customer returns portal on Standard and above.
API access for custom integrations, and advanced inventory/warehouse management plus custom analytics on the Premium tier.

limitations.en: Advanced inventory and warehouse management features are reserved for the Premium tier, starting at $349.99/month.
Cost rises steeply with shipment volume within the same plan, which can make budgeting unpredictable for growing stores.
